item.title: Minister of State says meeting with families affected by North Kerry CAMHS care was harrowing
item.description: The Minister of State for Mental Health says meeting with the families of children affected by the care provided to them at North Kerry CAMHS was harrowing. A report found that 56% of children in the care of North Kerry Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services were at risk of potential harm from their treatment. item.description: Jessie Buckley is among those nominated for an Irish Film and Television award, as the ceremony gets underway this evening. The Killarney native will attend alongside fellow nominees Cillian Murphy, Jonathan Rhys Meyers and Steve Coogan. item.title: Broadband restored in Abbeydorney after prolonged outage
item.description: Homes and businesses in part of Abbeydorney were left without broadband for over a week. Last Thursday week, a vehicle struck a pole in the Ballymacquinn area, resulting in telecommuncation outages locally. Broadband provider Eir told Radio Kerry that repairs are now completed and broadband has been restored. item.title: Chinese Ambassador to Ireland on first official visit to Kerry
item.description: The Chinese Ambassador to Ireland is on his first official visit to Kerry. The Ambassador of the People’s Republic of China to Ireland, Zhao Xiyuan arrived in Tralee earlier today. He was invited to Tralee by the Kerry Chinese New Year organising committee, and he’ll attend the celebrations in The Square in Tralee tomorrow. item.title: First of mass evictions from Loreto Chapel Estate in Killarney to take place next week
item.description: The first expulsion in an impending mass eviction of twelve families from the Loreto Chapel Estate in Killarney is due to take place next week. Councillor Deirdre Ferris drew the matter to the attention of Kerry County Council once again, at this week’s full council meeting. The Cypriot property company, Xerico Ltd, owns 14 houses in the Loreto convent development. Advertisement It began a mass eviction process against the 34 residents, including 15 children, last year. item.title: Keane being considered for Palace job
item.description: Robbie Keane is reportedly being considered as a possible replacement for Crystal Palace manager Oliver Glasner. The current boss is due to be leaving at the end of the season, but his team have stalled badly, and won just once in their last 15 games across all competitions. Advertisement
